payload.source_text: is the add that summons Psycheflayer. Players should dodge his circular AoE spell named Void Fire II. At around half HP, He summons the Psycheflayer.
is the add that summons Psycheflayer. Players should dodge his circular AoE spell named Void Fire II. At around half HP, He summons the Psycheflayer.
has a very large circular AoE attack that centers around itself. The attack, named Plaincracker, deals massive amount of damage to all players hit.
is an ability that spawns a long black column in the middle of the boss room. It will do a large amount of damage and inflict the debuff heavy Heavy to all players hit.
is an ability that spawns two long black columns at the sides of the boss room. It will do a large amount of damage and inflict the debuff slow Slow to all players hit.

has an ability named Thunderstorm. Thunderstorm is a circular AoE spell that inflicts the debuff paralysis Paralysis to all targets caught within. The spell should be interrupted with a stun because it is difficult to avoid the ground indicator.
is a rear cone AoE attack that deals high amount of damage and inflicts a DoT named Concussion to all players hit. Anantaboga will only use this ability when one or more players are behind it.
has an ability named Terror Eye that places a circular AoE under a random player. It deals heavy damage to all players caught within.
a conal AoE from the boss that afflicts a cleansable paralysis Paralysis detrimental effect.
an uncasted circular AoE around a random party member, dealing moderate damage.
a casted conal AoE toward the main target.

the boss will target a random party member and encase them in a Queer Bubble add, inflicting bind Bind, Physical Damage Down (decreases the player's physical damage), Mana Modulation (decreases the player's damage dealt with spells and reduces HP restored via healing magic), and dropsy Dropsy. Kill the Queer Bubble to free and cleanse the afflicted party member's debuffs. Touchdown: very light damage and a knockback from where Aiatar first descends. Salivous Snap: a magical tankbuster that inflicts a cleansable poison Poison detriment. Dragon Breath: a line AoE targeting a random party member. Inflicts poison Poison if hit.

the boss will target a random party member and encase them in a Queer Bubble add, inflicting bind Bind, Physical Damage Down (decreases the player's physical damage), Mana Modulation (decreases the player's damage dealt with spells and reduces HP restored via healing magic), and dropsy Dropsy. Kill the Queer Bubble to free and cleanse the afflicted party member's debuffs. Touchdown: very light damage and a knockback from where Aiatar first descends. Salivous Snap: a magical tankbuster that inflicts a cleansable poison Poison detriment. Dragon Breath: a line AoE targeting a random party member. Inflicts poison Poison if hit.

four small circular AoEs that appear around the arena. Will spawn poisonous pods that will grow in size and eventually explode in wider AoEs. Inflicts poison Poison. After the first cast of Toxic Vomit, a second set of poisonous pods will follow the first set, and explode after first set. Dodge into where the first poisonous pods were after they explode.

four small circular AoEs that appear around the arena. Will spawn poisonous pods that will grow in size and eventually explode in wider AoEs. Inflicts poison Poison. After the first cast of Toxic Vomit, a second set of poisonous pods will follow the first set, and explode after first set. Dodge into where the first poisonous pods were after they explode.
a line AoE targeting a random party member. Inflicts poison Poison if hit.
a casted circular AoE around a player.
a line AoE targetting a random player.
casted circular AoE that will target a random player.

At around 75%, 50%, and 25% HP, the boss will start circling the room's outer perimeter and become un-targetable, dealing damage to players within its path. One Illuminati Sniper and one Illuminati Glider adds will spawn. A few seconds later, it will launch a massive amount of bombs that cover the entire area. These can be knocked away with attacks and should be moved away from the center with AoE attacks quickly before they explode. The boss will stop and becomes targetable again afterwards.

The third and final intermission phase will be followed by the boss summoning a Giant Bomb, which must be killed quickly. The boss will begin to rush through the middle of the arena during this phase, dealing moderate damage to players and potentially stun-locking them.
Summons additional imperial soldiers to the battle.
A large circular AoE attack that targets a random player, dealing heavy damage to all players hit.
An untelegraphed line attack that deals heavy damage to all players directly in front of the boss.
The boss will reposition at the center of the arena and fire a donut AoE and circle AoE, leaving only a small donut as a safe spot.
The boss will reposition at the center of the arena and fire a donut AoE and circle AoE, leaving only a small donut as a safe spot.
A frontal cone AoE attack that deals heavy amount of damage and inflicts the debuff Paralysis to all players hit.
Drops an AoE on all players that must be avoided by moving out of it.
Livia will reposition to the center and cast a circle AoE followed by 8 AoEs on the border of the arena. Avoid by moving out then moving in.

A sequence of a large line AoE down the center of the arena followed by 6 circle AoEs on the sides of it. Livia will cast this four times on various sides of the arena before ending with Angry Salamander. Players must remember the order in which the AoEs appear to avoid them sequentially.

A sequence of a large line AoE down the center of the arena followed by 6 circle AoEs on the sides of it. Livia will cast this four times on various sides of the arena before ending with Angry Salamander. Players must remember the order in which the AoEs appear to avoid them sequentially.

A cast in preparation for the following two moves: Stunning Sweep: Circular AoE attack that is done at the same time as 6 other AoEs on the outside of the arena, leaving two safe areas on opposite edges. This is followed by two flare markers on the the safe spot. Players must get into the safe zone and then leave once the other AoEs go off. Angry Salamander: 8 line AoEs will go off in the middle of the arena, followed by four flare markers on the edge. Players must move in between two of the line AoEs and move back into the center.

A cast in preparation for the following two moves: Stunning Sweep: Circular AoE attack that is done at the same time as 6 other AoEs on the outside of the arena, leaving two safe areas on opposite edges. This is followed by two flare markers on the the safe spot. Players must get into the safe zone and then leave once the other AoEs go off. Angry Salamander: 8 line AoEs will go off in the middle of the arena, followed by four flare markers on the edge. Players must move in between two of the line AoEs and move back into the center.

A cast in preparation for the following two moves: Stunning Sweep: Circular AoE attack that is done at the same time as 6 other AoEs on the outside of the arena, leaving two safe areas on opposite edges. This is followed by two flare markers on the the safe spot. Players must get into the safe zone and then leave once the other AoEs go off. Angry Salamander: 8 line AoEs will go off in the middle of the arena, followed by four flare markers on the edge. Players must move in between two of the line AoEs and move back into the center.
Kottos will jump to 3 areas, causing a massive circle AoE to appear at the location. Players should move to the small safe spot at the edge of the arena.
Kottos will jump to 3 areas, causing a massive circle AoE to appear at the location. Players should move to the small safe spot at the edge of the arena.
A large cone AoE targeted on a random player.
Circle AoEs will appear below all players, requiring them to move out of it.
After 50% HP, Ichorous Ire will split up into many Ichorous Drips, which will each cast Burst, a circle AoE centered on the enemy.
A massive donut AoE centered on the boss. Players must move into the boss' hitbox to avoid excess damage.
The boss will recenter and cast a circle AoE in the center along with 5 more on the outside of the arena. Players should move into the safe spots in between the AoEs.
A large cone AoE targeted on a random player.
is a telegraphed circle AoE on a player's location.
is a telegraphed frontal conal AoE.
is the least dangerous add type. It only has a basic attack.
is a slightly stronger add. It also has Mandible Bite, the frontal AoE cone ability.

is the strongest add. It has an AoE frontal cone ability, Mandible Bite, that damages all targets caught within. The Marshal can also use an ability named Formic Pheromones, which puts a Vulnerability Down buff on Myrmidon Princess. Will be indicated by it tethering to the Princess.

is the strongest add. It has an AoE frontal cone ability, Mandible Bite, that damages all targets caught within. The Marshal can also use an ability named Formic Pheromones, which puts a Vulnerability Down buff on Myrmidon Princess. Will be indicated by it tethering to the Princess.
Telegraphed circle AoEs at two random players' locations.
is a frontal line AoE attack.

is a sequence of circle AoEs: three on the walls; then three more on the walls, leaving a safe zone in the center; then a final AoE covering the center. Dodge to the center, then dodge out after the first set of AoEs go off.

is a sequence of circle AoEs: three on the walls; then three more on the walls, leaving a safe zone in the center; then a final AoE covering the center. Dodge to the center, then dodge out after the first set of AoEs go off.
has two types of attacks, Firewater and Boulderdash. Firewater is a set of 4 circular AoEs around the arena. Boulderdash is an instant cast that hits all players.
is a frontal AoE cone attack that deals a large amount of damage to targets hit.
is a frontal AoE cone attack that deals more damage than Double Smash. Taulurd starts to use this when it is under half HP.
is a circle AoE that deals moderate damage to all players around him.
Circular AoE.
Circular AoE.

The boss will start charging electricity, giving a purple glow to the entire pool of water. Retreat to the dirt slopes on the edge of the arena until the attack goes off. Ranged party members can still hit the boss while standing on the slope.

At around 80% health, the boss gains a fire shield that makes it invulnerable. Two torches will light up and start spawning fire wisps, which will approach the boss, and will explode into room-wide AoEs if they reach it. Kill the wisps to disable the shield, which will give the message: . This move is repeated at about 60% HP.
Multi-stage AoE that starts as a circle, then two concentric donuts. Stand outside the initial circle, then when it goes off, move into it to avoid the donuts.
Circular AoE.
is an untelegraphed cone AoE melee attack.
There are 6 banana trees along the edges of the arena. Interacting with the tree drops a Banana Bunch on the ground. Used to interupt Chest Thump. Grants the boss a stacking damage buff.

Small monkeys that spawn around when the boss casts Chest Thump. Will move towards and eat Banana Bunches. Should be killed quickly and/or tanked away from where the Banana Bunches are being summoned.
Long frontal line AoE.

Large bubbles that spawn around the room in a 3x3 grid. Used to avoid Whirlpool. Imobilizes and deals slight damage to players while inside, and deals additional damage in an arena-wide AoE when the bubbles pop.
There are 4 platforms in the arena that players can use Waterspouts to get to.
Used to move between Platforms. Applies a 15-second stacking Suppuration debuff when used; avoid excessive/repeated use in a short time to keep the debuff down.

One is spawned on each Platform. Killing one spawns a second at the same platform that needs to be killed as well. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Inkblot: A large AoE on a random player. Applies a slow debuff and a DoT. Clearout: Donut AoE. Stand within the hitbox to avoid being hit. Knocks back affected players, potentially into a Waterspout.

One is spawned on each Platform. Killing one spawns a second at the same platform that needs to be killed as well. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Inkblot: A large AoE on a random player. Applies a slow debuff and a DoT. Clearout: Donut AoE. Stand within the hitbox to avoid being hit. Knocks back affected players, potentially into a Waterspout.

One is spawned on each Platform. Killing one spawns a second at the same platform that needs to be killed as well. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Inkblot: A large AoE on a random player. Applies a slow debuff and a DoT. Clearout: Donut AoE. Stand within the hitbox to avoid being hit. Knocks back affected players, potentially into a Waterspout.

One is spawned on each Platform. Killing one spawns a second at the same platform that needs to be killed as well. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Inkblot: A large AoE on a random player. Applies a slow debuff and a DoT. Clearout: Donut AoE. Stand within the hitbox to avoid being hit. Knocks back affected players, potentially into a Waterspout.

Appears after 4 Arms have been killed. Killing it spawns a second, final tentacle. Should be focused over the Arm as it has more health and is more annoying. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Scoop: Will pick up players, immobilizing them, and throw them onto random platforms.

Appears after 4 Arms have been killed. Killing it spawns a second, final tentacle. Should be focused over the Arm as it has more health and is more annoying. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Scoop: Will pick up players, immobilizing them, and throw them onto random platforms.

Appears after 4 Arms have been killed. Killing it spawns a second, final tentacle. Should be focused over the Arm as it has more health and is more annoying. Wallop: frontal cone AoE. Scoop: Will pick up players, immobilizing them, and throw them onto random platforms.

Marks 1-2 players with a large green meteor icon. After a few seconds, they will drop a tornado where they are standing. A few more seconds after that, the tornado will explode, dealing heavy damage to all players in a massive AoE around it. Marked players should bring the marker to another island and drop it along the far edge and return, with the rest of the group moving against the far wall on the platform they stayed on.
Napalm first, Balloon second and Vassago third.
straight line AoE from the boss's position.

makes either 1 or 2 large circular puddles on the ground. The puddle(s) will expand 2 times, and touching them will give a Corrupting Crystal stack. If there's one puddle, stay around the edges of the arena. If there are two, then try to split the party across the two safe zones, to minimize splash damage from Corrupting Crystal explosions.
Large donut AoE at the center of the room. Anyone hit by this will get the Siren Song debuff. Stay in the center of the arena (the circle of metal grates) to avoid it, or interrupt the cast.
Straight line AoE that goes through the center of the arena.

a conal AoE directed to the main target. Inflicts Silence if hit. Players can interact with the grate when it is bubbling to prevent an add from spawning. To this extent, ranged DPS can position themselves to be in range to attack, while still able to quickly interact with the grates when they bubble. Should adds spawn, try to keep their numbers down to prevent the tank from being overwhelmed. If a caster is targeted by the adds, they should run to the tank so that the tank can remove hate while staying by the boss. In most runs, the grates and the adds they spawn are generally ignored, and all damage is focused on the boss.

a conal AoE directed to the main target. Inflicts Silence if hit. Players can interact with the grate when it is bubbling to prevent an add from spawning. To this extent, ranged DPS can position themselves to be in range to attack, while still able to quickly interact with the grates when they bubble. Should adds spawn, try to keep their numbers down to prevent the tank from being overwhelmed. In most runs, the grates and the adds they spawn are generally ignored, and all damage is focused on the boss.
Summons AoE circles beneath each player. Inflicts a stack of File:Frozen icon1.png Frozen debuff.
Frontal cone AoE.
Summons six untargetable snowballs, each with a point blank AoE. Yeti will breathe on one to two of the snowballs, increasing the size of the snowball and it's resulting AoE.
Point blank AoE, immediately followed by a donut AoE.
a cone attack in front of Fenrir which puts no AoE indicator on the ground but has a long animation time. Move to Fenrir's sides or rear.
Four icicles drop to the ground in a diamond pattern, preempted by circular AoE indicators. Immediately followed by Lunar Cry.

Long-duration cast that will instantly knock out any players not hiding behind an icicle. The first time Lunar Cry is cast, you can hide behind any of the four icicles to block the attack. After the first Lunar Cry, you must hide behind the icicle which stays blue. The other three of the four icicles will start blue, but turn pink in color and then shatter. As soon as Lunar Cry finishes, the icicle will explode in a circular AoE, freezing nearby players for 10 seconds and applying damage over time. Either stand far enough away from the icicle while also remaining out of sight, or stay near the icicle and be prepared to move quickly after the cast finishes.

it's the same mechanic as Ancient Flare from the final boss in Labyrinth of Ancients formerly known as Acheron and now Phlegethon. Each group must stack on a small platform energized by the lightning orbs, which raises a shield that blocks the Daybreak cast. If stacking is not properly performed, then the shield fails.
is a circular AoE spell that appears under a random player. It deals moderate damage to all players hit.
(1 Hand) is a frontal cone AoE attack that does a large amount of damage to all targets hit.
(2 Hand) is a circular AoE attack that does extremely large amount of damage to all targets close to the Cyclops.
is a partial donut AoE spell that deals a moderate amount of damage and inflicts a DoT named Electrocution. This C-shaped attack has safe spots behind the boss and close in.

is a frontal cone AoE spell that inflicts the debuffs paralysis Paralysis, silence Silence, poison Poison, blind Blind, slow Slow, heavy Heavy, and File:HP penalty icon1.png HP Penalty to all targets hit.
is an ability that deals a small amount of damage and adds one stack of link= Burrs on a random player.

Untargettable clones of Einhander appear small untargetable Einhanders will appear, holding ceruleum tanks, which they will drop onto the platform. Keep your distance from the glowing red tanks to avoid the large circle attacks around them. After the first tanks explode, more may begin to glow, so be sure to avoid those as well. Mark XLT Quick-firing cannon: At the same time, Einhander will fire a line Aoe that causes at least two of the tanks to glow and explode.

Untargettable clones of Einhander appear small untargetable Einhanders will appear, holding ceruleum tanks, which they will drop onto the platform. Keep your distance from the glowing red tanks to avoid the large circle attacks around them. After the first tanks explode, more may begin to glow, so be sure to avoid those as well. Mark XLT Quick-firing cannon: At the same time, Einhander will fire a line Aoe that causes at least two of the tanks to glow and explode.

The gunship will periodically target a player with Flame Thrower, a large frontal cone attack. This attack lasts for several seconds, so get out of the attack marker and stay out of the flame area to avoid damage.
Circular AoE
A very wide line attack from the boss.
A donut attack where the safe area is near the boss.
The boss summons two untargetable Mirage Dragons. Both of them cast Admonishment, while Midgardsormr follows up Inner Turmoil and Outer Turmoil to leave even less room for players to dodge.

The boss becomes untargetable, summons Mirage Dragons again, and begins charging up a Midgardsormr's Aether for his ultimate attack. As the dragons are now targetable, they must be defeated before the gauge reaches 100%, in which case Animadversion will wipe the party.
This is the first time players will see a multi-stack marker, which results in multiple attacks instead of just once. Be sure to stay stacked until the attacks stop.

a person will be marked with Prey. After a delay, the person will get devoured and will be unable to execute any actions. After the person is devoured, the boss will have a Voracious Maw add, which should be defeated to free the victim. If this add is not killed within a timeframe, the victim will be spat out and be KO'd.
a medium-sized circular AoE that leaves a puddle, inflicting Pollen to people standing in it, dealing damage-overtime. Being hit with the initial AoE will inflict Reduced Immunity.
a large conal AoE.
a donut-AoE centered around the boss.
Four circle AoEs will appear from the center and move toward the outside of the arena.
Circle AoEs will be placed on every player, requiring them to spread out.
Circle AoEs will be placed on every player, requiring them to spread out.
A cone AoE targeting a random player.
A frontal cone AoE that knocks players back.
Summons a Magitek Death Claw that tethers to one player and slowly moves towards them, knocking player back when it gets to them. The players not tethered should kill it.
Summons a Magitek Death Claw that tethers to one player and slowly moves towards them, knocking player back when it gets to them. The players not tethered should kill it.

A stack on a random player, followed by Wheel of Suffering centered on the targeted player. Wheel of Suffering: A circle AoE that deals damage to all players near the boss. Players should stack together then move out of the following AoE.

A stack on a random player, followed by Wheel of Suffering centered on the targeted player. Wheel of Suffering: A circle AoE that deals damage to all players near the boss. Players should stack together then move out of the following AoE.
Nero will hop to one side of the arena and attack a large portion of the arena with a cone AoE that should be avoided.
Gaius will fire several blue, flaming Xs. After a few seconds, a line AoE blast comes from the X dealing heavy damage to any players in its path.
A stack marker on a random player.
Three circular AoEs appear on the short side of the arena and move along the length of the platform.
Three circular AoEs appear on the short side of the arena and move along the length of the platform.
Each player will be marked by an unavoidable circle AoE. Players should spread out to avoid excess damage.
Each player will be marked by an unavoidable circle AoE. Players should spread out to avoid excess damage.
is a frontal AoE cone attack that deals a moderate amount of damage and inflicts the debuffs Silence and Pacification for 5 seconds on all targets hit.
is a circular AoE targeted on a random party member. Dodge out of the AoE indicator.

spawns three whirlwinds at the back of the arena the first time it is cast and four thereafter. For the first cast, simply move to the empty lane to avoid the whirlwinds. In the second cast and all following it, when two whirlwinds begin to move players should stand in front of one that is still stationary. Once the first two have gone past, dodge behind them into the safe space created to avoid the second pair. Which two move first is random, so keep an eye on them when they spawn to determine how to react.
is a frontal cone AoE attack that deals heavy damage to all targets hit.
is circular AoE that targets a random player. It deals a moderate amount of damage and inflicts the debuff Frostbite. The AoE can be avoided if the affected player moves quickly.

is an ability that turns about a third of the room an icy blue color. After a few seconds, Isgebind flies over the area and deals damage and inflicts the debuff Frostbite to all targets in area. After the third Cauterize attack, Sheet of Ice AoEs will target all players two times in a row before Isgebind returns. With the 6.1 update, positioning during this double attack is not as important as it once was, but the party should be sure to avoid stacking. Dodge out of these circular AoEs as before.
- A large frontal cone AoE. Use Sprint to stay behind him to not get hit.
Telegraphed point-blank AoE. Anyone hit will receive a 15-second Physical Vulnerability Up which can be cleansed with Esuna.
Telegraphed frontal conal AoE. Anyone hit will receive a 15-second Poison which can be cleansed with Esuna.
is a frontal cone AoE attack that will inflict a 15-second Blind which can be cleansed with Esuna.

Spawns two Mythril Verges. Defeat these adds as soon as possible. These will aim at at random players with Verge Line, a blue telegraphed line AoE. Each time they use their AoE, they will gain a stack of Haste, increasing the rate of their attacks. If the adds reach 6 stacks, they will instantly explode with Self-Destruct for high party-wide damage.

Spawns two Mythril Verges. Defeat these adds as soon as possible. These will aim at at random players with Verge Line, a blue telegraphed line AoE. Each time they use their AoE, they will gain a stack of Haste, increasing the rate of their attacks. If the adds reach 6 stacks, they will instantly explode with Self-Destruct for high party-wide damage.

Now spawns four Mythril Verges, one per corner. Each add will chain a player, briefly stunning and drawing them in, inflicting bind. All players will then be targeted with Verge Pulse by their respective add. If it connects, the player will instantly die. Players must defeat their adds to free themselves and dodge the AoE. Freed players should help defeat other adds to free their allies.
A massive telegraphed conal AoE aimed at a random player. To facilitate dodging, do not be too far away from the boss.
A telegraphed circle AoE at one random player's current location.
Summons four Mythril verges again, but similar to the first usage of this attack (without players being chained).
a buff that adds additional lightning damage to auto attacks. Initial cast can be interrupted.
conal AoE.
additional light damage to the main target, with lifesteal. Used after the first set of adds.
An instant circle AoE around the boss that deals moderate damage.
A line AoE targeting a random player.

Graffias targets a random player, dealing minor damage and spawning an untargetable Fleshy Pod add at their position. After a few seconds, the add explodes with Pod Burst, dealing moderate damage in a circle AoE and inflicting any players hit with a Poison debuff.

Graffias targets a random player, dealing minor damage and spawning an untargetable Fleshy Pod add at their position. After a few seconds, the add explodes with Pod Burst, dealing moderate damage in a circle AoE and inflicting any players hit with a Poison debuff.
is a large frontal cone AoE attack that pulls players into Keeper of Halidom's melee range.
is a large circular AoE attack that targets a random player and deals moderate amount of damage and inflicts a debuff that reduces healing received to all players hit.
A telegraphed wide frontal conal AoE in front of the boss (leaving the sides or behind safe). Will also spawn a dangerous AoE around the arena.
A telegraphed wide frontal conal AoE in front of the boss (leaving the sides or behind safe). Will also spawn a dangerous AoE around the arena.

A telegraphed wide AoE that now hits to the sides and behind (leaving the front safe). A purple line will begin connecting the five nodes starting from the northwest or northeast, indicating the order in which they will resolve an AoE. Each node will also be given a green indicator: A plus indicates a plus-shaped AoE (Pathocross Purge) originating from the node, and a circle indicates a donut AoE (Pathocircuit Purge) originating from the node. Players must pay attention to the green indicator and dodge the AoEs in the order they resolve, as they have late ground telegraphs. During the last set of AoEs, the boss will begin casting another Immune Response (front or side/rear cleave).

Telegraphed AoE tankbuster (Disinfection) and a stack marker on a random player. The tank should stay out while the other players stack together. The order is: Node 1 > Node 2 + Immune Response > Node 3 > Node 4 > Node 5 > Immune Response Using Sprint is recommended.
Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.
Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.
An electric line will spawn through where the boss is facing, indicating a late telegraphed line AoE in that direction, leaving the sides of the boss's hitbox safe.
An electric line will spawn through where the boss is facing, indicating a late telegraphed line AoE in that direction, leaving the sides of the boss's hitbox safe.
Similar to Centralized Current, but will now indicate two line AoEs hitting the sides of the boss.
is used again, now also causing three sets of baited circle AoEs to appear beneath players. This is then followed with the same triangle/line AoEs and spread markers as before.
is used again, now also causing three sets of baited circle AoEs to appear beneath players. This is then followed with the same triangle/line AoEs and spread markers as before.
is used again, now also causing three sets of baited circle AoEs to appear beneath players. This is then followed with the same triangle/line AoEs and spread markers as before.
Stack marker AoE dealing magical damage.
A telegraphed point-blank AoE followed by two telegraphed concentric donut AoEs.
A telegraphed point-blank AoE followed by two telegraphed concentric donut AoEs.
Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.
Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.

The boss's floating hand (Elimination Claw) will move to west/east wall and begin charging energy, indicating a line AoE (Terminate) through where it is facing. In addition, the boss will cast another Reconfigured Partition, causing both AoEs to resolve at once, leaving two corners safe.

The boss's floating hand (Elimination Claw) will move to west/east wall and begin charging energy, indicating a line AoE (Terminate) through where it is facing. In addition, the boss will cast another Reconfigured Partition, causing both AoEs to resolve at once, leaving two corners safe.

Begins another set of AoEs. The boss's floating node (Elimbit) will converge lasers near the north/south wall, indicating a donut AoE (Halo of Destruction). Meanwhile, the boss will cast another Partition, leaving only half of the middle of the donut safe. After the AoEs resolve, each player is given a spread AoE marker (Electray) that deals magical damage and inflicts lightning resistance down Lightning Resistance Down II, making overlap lethal.

Begins another set of AoEs. The boss's floating node (Elimbit) will converge lasers near the north/south wall, indicating a donut AoE (Halo of Destruction). Meanwhile, the boss will cast another Partition, leaving only half of the middle of the donut safe. After the AoEs resolve, each player is given a spread AoE marker (Electray) that deals magical damage and inflicts lightning resistance down Lightning Resistance Down II, making overlap lethal.
Line stack marker on a random player, dealing magical damage.

The boss becomes untargetable and summons six Lightning Generators that need to be killed before the Charge gauge reaches 100. During this sequence, players will need to dodge donut AoEs from the Elimbit and line AoEs from the Elimination Claw which have the same indicators as before. There will be another line stack marker as well although it is possible to skip this with enough DPS.

The boss raises either its left or right leg, indicating which poison puddle will be hit, causing it to release multiple late telegraph circle AoEs (Pod Burst) in semi-random locations on its half of the room and partially covering the other half. This attack will be used multiple times in succession. You should position yourself somewhere in the middle and immediately start moving to the safe side (edge of the arena of the safe side as AoEs can cover a bigger area). When the AoEs go off you should quickly start moving to the middle to be able to get to the other side for the next Venomspill. The last Venomspill will likely be on the same side as the previous one.
